schema_review.rationale: Full Server upgrades from 1.3.0 remain mandatory on SQLite, embedded seekDB and OceanBase. The reviewed persistence changes include pc_portable_restore_receipts and MySQL DATETIME(6) precision for artifact creation, profile policy updates, Topic Memory publication and tag assignment; the migrated database must match a fresh target database, including these objects. Batch source, artifact, Candidate, projection and authorization operations, SQLite snapshot transactions, blank-source admission and Topic Memory rejection handling require the existing data-preservation and authorization acceptance checks. Arithmetic CHECK reflection, seekDB server identification, explicit legacy-memory owner decisions and frozen-snapshot memory budgets improve migration probing and safety but do not supply a complete Server migration chain. This review records the target persistence inputs, not successful upgrade support. The policy stays upgrade-required; publication remains blocked until the full migration integration tracked in #2154 / #2168 and all three installed-release acceptance cases pass.
